description: Cross-venue spread between Kalshi and Polymarket for the same resolving question. The two venues sometimes price the same outcome 2-25pp apart because their participant pools differ, when the bet shapes are equivalent that delta is a real signal, when they aren't the tool says so. TWO MODES: (1) `topic`, 11 pre-mapped macro subjects ("fed", "btc", "eth", "cpi", "gdp", "sp500", "recession", "next_pope", "next_uk_pm", "next_israel_pm", "2028_president") auto-fetch the matching event on each venue.

kalshi_event_ticker.description: Explicit Kalshi event ticker, e.g. "KXFED-26OCT". Overrides the topic-mapped Kalshi side.

polymarket_event_slug.description: Explicit Polymarket event slug, e.g. "fed-decision-in-june-825". Overrides the topic-mapped Polymarket side.

topic.description: Subject to compare. Canonical keys: fed | btc | eth | cpi | gdp | sp500 | recession | next_pope | next_uk_pm | next_israel_pm | 2028_president, plus the 15-minute crypto up/down windows btc_15m | eth_15m | sol_15m | xrp_15m | bnb_15m ("btc 15m", "bitcoin 15 minute"), which are answered by updown_venue_compare for the window in progress, but aliases and keywords resolve too ("bitcoin", "fed rate decision", "ethereum", "inflation", "s&p 500", "us recession", "next pope", "2028 election"). Check resolution.topic_matched_by in the response: "exact"/"alias" is a curated pairing, "phrase"/"token" is a keyword guess.

name: nist-fluid-properties__polymarket_kalshi_spread
